title: Oven Roasted American Potato Casserole
description: A sweet and creamy American dish featuring small potatoes and ferment-jang, perfect for a keto-friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the halved potatoes with salt and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the potatoes out in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
While the potatoes are roasting, cook the chopped bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy.
In a separate bowl, mix together the sour cream, ferment-jang, and shredded cheddar cheese.
After the potatoes have roasted for 20 minutes, remove them from the oven and top with the sour cream mixture and crispy bacon.
Return the potatoes to the oven and continue to roast for an additional 15 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
Remove the potatoes from the oven and sprinkle with chopped scallions.
Serve the casserole hot and enjoy.
